Last week, a court ruled that rape and sexual assault qualify as gender-motivated violence, empowering survivors to seek accountability through civil suits in New York City. This is a victory for the #MeToo movement and for survivors of sexual violence. 
https://t.co/IKqpXwxwl0

William Green should be alive today.

Officer Michael Owen had fatally shot someone while on duty before. We need stronger mechanisms to truly hold police accountable for the harms they cause. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/zXLdQVg3YI

Trayvon Martin would have been 25 today. His legacy is honored every day by those who fight to end police violence and dismantle our country's legacy of racial terror. Happy birthday, Trayvon. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/nmdDmu9hcr
Rest in Power, Eric and Erica Garner. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ZZJnIbtidv

Social justice means confronting the pervasive effects of sexual assault and violence in our communities. Today, and every day, we thank @TaranaBurke for her work as the founder of the #MeToo movement and her advocacy for survivors everywhere. #BlackHistoryMonth https://t.co/vIdfqdFhLy
Our thoughts today are with everyone who came forward about Harvey Weinstein, who was inspired by the #MeToo movement to speak up, and who is fighting to combat sexual violence in America.
